is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 1, title and abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc L995F (kdr-west), Vgsc L995S (kdr-east), and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (page 5, Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 5 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for kdr-west, kdr-east, and Ace-1 (G119S) for four locations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from four LGAs in Lagos State, Nigeria (page 5, Materials and Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field and laboratory data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for four specific LGAs: Alimosho, Kosofe, Ibeju-Lekki, and Badagry (page 5, Table 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was received in 2019 and published in 2020, implying a recent collection window.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection of mosquitoes from Lagos State.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Table 1, 2, and 3).

assessment.summary: This study reports on insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. from four LGAs in Lagos State, Nigeria. It includes bioassay results for DDT, permethrin, and bendiocarb, and genotypes for kdr-west (L1014F), kdr-east (L1014S), and Ace-1 (G119S).
